result.summary: The main visual defect is overlapping restaurant metadata in the first “Popular right now” card; the rest of the page appears generally coherent, with horizontal carousels intentionally extending beyond the screen edge.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery-time and delivery-fee/cuisine metadata beneath the restaurant name overlap each other. Text such as “25–30 min” and “€0 delivery” is rendered on top of itself, making the details difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Correct the metadata row layout so each item has its own space and baseline. Use a flex row with appropriate gaps, wrapping, or a separate line when the available width is insufficient.
